reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: `getAllMemberNames` exists at members.ts:187 and has a live non-test caller (MemberManagementClient.tsx:660). Gate 2: No `trust_assumptions` defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack path originates from an authenticated Discord OAuth user session (not a trusted internal component). Gate 3: No applicable out-of-scope exclusion. An attacker can trigger this via direct POST to the `getAllMemberNames` Server Action endpoint using a valid authenticated session cookie, causing full uid→real-name (本名) disclosure of all club members without any admin privilege check.
